title: Add RAG agent tool-calling quickstarts and docs update
author: Jordan Park
description:
Motivation: add a pair of RAG agent quickstarts that demonstrate tool-calling patterns (external search + internal catalog lookup) and update the docs site quickstart pages. These examples are intended to provide reference implementations for customers using Redwood to run RAG agents with tool integrations (HTTP tools, database lookups) and to show recommended prompt/templates for retrieval + tool orchestration.

What this PR does: 1) Adds two quickstart example apps under redwood-examples/agents/rag-tool-calling (node and python) that wire up the agent runner, a retriever mock, and two tool adapters (search HTTP tool + catalog DB lookup). 2) Adds RAG agent templates (prompt + structured output schema) to docs content so the docs site can render reproducible templates. 3) Updates the docs quickstarts pages to include a Tool Calling section and code snippets. 4) Small adjustments to the agent SDK docs to call out streaming/tool progress and error handling.

Checklist:
- [x] Add example code for Node quickstart
- [x] Add example code for Python quickstart
- [x] Add RAG templates to docs content
- [x] Update docs site navigation and quickstart page
- [x] Add unit tests for template loader and tool adapter shim
- [x] CI passes (docs build + tests)

Commits (summary):
- add(node): initial rag tool-calling node quickstart and README
- add(python): python quickstart + requirements and sample retriever
- docs: rag templates + quickstart docs update
- sdk: add ToolAdapter shim and examples in agent docs
- test: add unit tests for template loader and tool adapter error paths

Changed areas (high-level):
- redwood-examples/agents/rag-tool-calling/node/quickstart.js
- redwood-examples/agents/rag-tool-calling/node/README.md
- redwood-examples/agents/rag-tool-calling/python/quickstart.py
- docs/content/quickstarts/rag-agent.md (new Tool Calling section + templates)
- docs/content/templates/rag-templates/* (new JSON prompt templates)
- sdk/agent/TOOL_ADAPTER.md (documentation + example usage)
- sdk/agent/template_loader_test.py (unit tests)

Testing notes: examples include mocked retriever and a small integration test that runs the agent end-to-end with a deterministic tool mock. Docs site was built locally (hugo) to validate markdown and template includes. CI runs: unit tests + docs build + lint; one flaky integration test was re-run and passed on the second attempt.

Why now: multiple customers requested canonical examples for tool-calling RAG agents; having these quickstarts reduces onboarding friction and provides templates for our Optimize/evals teams to validate retrieval+tool call correctness.

Followups: snapshotting the example datasets and adding a playground integration in the docs site (ENG-4822).
